# src/node/nrbf

The .NET Binary Format reader, ported to TypeScript.

| File | Purpose | Exports |
|---|---|---|
| `index.ts` | A reader for .NET's binary serialization format (NRBF), the encoding a save file is written in, and conversion of what it reads to plain JSON. | — |
| `reader.ts` | The NRBF reader: | NrbfValue, BinaryObject, NRBFReader |
| `to-json.ts` | — | nrbfToJSON |
| `types.ts` | The types `node/nrbf/` exports, in one place — so a neighbouring module finds the shape it needs here instead of declaring its own under a second name. | RecordType, PrimitiveType, BinaryType, BinaryArrayType |
